blocks.text: MULTI queues commands for EXEC. Redis runs that queued group without another client's commands between them.
Use a local Redis server and redis-cli. Commands here use cma: practice keys only. Redis commands do not run in the site's SQLite playground. Do not connect these exercises to a production database.

blocks.code:
MULTI
SET cma:points 2
INCR cma:points
EXEC
blocks.title: Group commands with MULTI

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `INCR` adds one to an integer string value as a single Redis operation.
`MULTI` queues Redis commands for EXEC. It does not provide SQL-style rollback of all runtime failures.

blocks.text: EXEC returns the results of setting the value and incrementing it to 3.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Redis transactions do not provide SQL-style rollback of commands that fail during execution. Validate the operations you queue.

blocks.text: Explain the final value after EXEC.
